chapter: Decca records, the Savoy and Moe Gale
title: How he got the nickname Hootie
summary: He explains his nickname Hootie came from getting sick on spiked beer at the Greenleaf Club, and that Jesse Price started it.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: You mentioned 'Hootie Blues', but you haven't explained how you go that nickname.

I tell you that nickname came from -- actually it came from when I first came to Kansas City, you know how it is with guys, new cat in town, here plays piano, so I would go down to cat's gigs and listen to different musicians so this particular night I went on down to the Greenleaf Club, so down there they would have that real cold beer but they would spike it with alcohol or gin so -- and the weather was nice and warm so when they passed it to me, man, it just tasted so good and cold. See, the alcohol got a tendency to make it

taste sweet, man, this is the best beer and I'm not a beer drinker and they'd pass it to the next guy and he would drink it and then pass it back to that new cat. Well, they're tricking me, see, they just take a little sip. Well, I'm thinking this is good beer and I would hold it up there and pass it on to somebody. Man, treat the visitor right. Give him another, pass it back over there. They pass it back over there to me and by that time, I got up to sit in and I played one number and I got up from there and had to go the restroom and let it up, you know, and the bad thing about it on the way to the restroom, it came up.

And everybody saw it. So the next day when they would mention me, they would say, you mean the new cat. You know, Hooty, the cat that got hooted on the gig last night. He got hooted, h-o-o-t-e-d, but when they talked about me, they talked about Hootie. So that's the way that thing -- the way the point me out to each other and Jessie Price, he was one of the main ones, you know, and he started that and then they -- when Dex would write me up, he'd write it up as Hootie, Jay Hootie.
I notice you said several times that different guys called you Mac. When you were a kid, did anyone call you Mac, then.
Yes, they would call Mac and -- that Hooties looked like it held on.
